facts.text: Independent Study, often called I.S., is a required senior research or creative project completed by every student at The College of Wooster.

sources.quote: Independent Study, often called I.S., is a required senior research or creative project completed by every student at The College of Wooster.

facts.text: On I.S. Monday, seniors submit their completed projects and celebrate months of focused work.

sources.title: Independent Study | The College of Wooster
sources.quote: On I.S. Monday, seniors submit their completed projects and celebrate months of focused work. For many students, it is one of the most meaningful days of their college experience.
